worked_solution:
Multiplying both sides of the given equality by $x(x+1)^{3}$ gives

$$
-{x}^{2}-3x-1=A(x+1)^{3}+Bx(x+1)^{2}+Cx(x+1)+Dx.
$$

Letting $x=-1$  gives

$$
\begin{aligned}-(-1)^{2}-3(-1)-1 & =A(-1+1)^{3}+B(-1)(-1+1)^{2}+C(-1)(-1+1)+D(-1) \\ -1+3-1 & =-D \\ 1 & =-D \\ D & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

Letting $x=0$  gives

$$
\begin{aligned}-(0)^{2}-3(0)-1 & =A(0+1)^{3}+B(0)(0+1)^{2}+C(0)(0+1)+D(0) \\ -1 & =A.\end{aligned}
$$

Letting $x=1$ and using our values for $A$ and $D$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}-(1)^{2}-3(1)-1 & =(-1)(1+1)^{3}+B(1)(1+1)^{2}+C(1)(1+1)+(-1)(1) \\ -1-3-1 & =-8+4B+2C-1 \\ 2C & =4-4B \\ C & =2-2B.\,\,(1)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, letting $x=2$ and using our values for $A$ and $D$ gives

$$
\begin{aligned}-(2)^{2}-3(2)-1 & =(-1)(2+1)^{3}+B(2)(2+1)^{2}+C(2)(2+1)+(-1)(2) \\ -4-6-1 & =-27+18B+6C-2 \\ 6C & =18-18B \\ C & =3-3B.\,\,(2)\end{aligned}
$$

From $(1)$ and $(2)$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}2-2B & =3-3B \\ B & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

Now we substitute the value of $B$ into $(1)$ to get the value of $C:$

$$
C=2-2(1)=0
$$

Finally,

$$
AB-CD=(-1)(1)-0(-1)=-1.
$$

Letting x=−1 gives −(−1)2−3(−1)−1=A(−1+1)3+B(−1)(−1+1)2+C(−1)(−1+1)+D(−1)−1+3−1=−D1=−DD=−1.

Letting x=0 gives −(0)2−3(0)−1=A(0+1)3+B(0)(0+1)2+C(0)(0+1)+D(0)−1=A.

Letting x=1 and using our values for A and D gives −(1)2−3(1)−1=(−1)(1+1)3+B(1)(1+1)2+C(1)(1+1)+(−1)(1)−1−3−1=−8+4B+2C−12C=4−4BC=2−2B.(1)

Now, letting x=2 and using our values for A and D gives −(2)2−3(2)−1=(−1)(2+1)3+B(2)(2+1)2+C(2)(2+1)+(−1)(2)−4−6−1=−27+18B+6C−26C=18−18BC=3−3B.(2)

From (1) and (2) we have 2−2B=3−3BB=1.

Now we substitute the value of B into (1) to get the value of C: C=2−2(1)=0

Finally, AB−CD=(−1)(1)−0(−1)=−1.
